purpose: Attach a name or label to something.
keywords: Name / quoted expression + という + noun.
There was a call from someone named Tanaka.
I am reading a book called Spring Wind.
I live in a town called Sakuramachi.
formation: Name / quoted expression + という + noun.
restrictions: The following noun names the category of the labeled thing.
mistake: It need not describe someone literally saying the name aloud.
